source_metadata.title: Cefadroxil as Oral Transitional Therapy for Gram-Positive Bacteremia With or Without Non-Vertebral Osteomyelitis: A Multicenter Retrospective Cohort Study

extraction_limitations: Only the primary PDF was provided; Supplementary Tables 1-6 referenced in the article were not available for direct extraction.
Subgroup findings that depend on Supplementary Tables 1-6 were retained only as main-text qualitative results; no unavailable subgroup numerics were invented.
The study is observational; extracted treatment comparisons are reported associations and should not be interpreted as randomized equivalence or noninferiority.
